Label colour that contrasts with a fill

Source: R/plots.R
contrast_label_color.Rd

Internal helper. A fill whose Rec. 601 luma (0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B, on a 0-255 scale) is below threshold counts as dark and gets a white label; lighter fills get light. With the threshold of 150 the Stem diverging palettes keep their labels (white on the dark extremes, dark on the light middle colours).

Usage

contrast_label_color(fill, light = "black", threshold = 150)

Arguments

fill

Character vector of fill colours.

light

Label colour used on light fills.

threshold

Luma below which a fill counts as dark.

Value

Character vector of label colours.
